ma.setBackgroundTextStyle(Object object)

Dynamically set the font of the pull-down background and the style of the loading chart.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
textStyle String Yes Font of the pull-down background and style of the loading chart.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Valid Values of object.textStyle

Value Description
dark dark style.
light light style.

Sample Code

    ma.setBackgroundTextStyle({
      textStyle: 'dark' // The style of the font of the pull-down background and loading chart is dark.
    })
